§ 01 • Clinical Background & Objectives

Continuous Actigraphy for Objective Depression Assessment

Overcoming subjective diagnostic recall bias using continuous wearable Internet-of-Medical-Things (IoMT)

Current Clinical Reality

Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) affects over 300 million people globally.

Current diagnosis relies on retrospective self-reports (MADRS, HDRS) and sporadic consultations.

Core limitation: Severe recall bias, lack of continuous longitudinal granularity, and episodic latency.

300M+
Affected Globally (WHO)
Passive Wearable Proxy

Continuous wrist actigraphy records motion signals 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Directly quantifies psychomotor retardation, diurnal cycle flattening, and nocturnal sleep fragmentation.

Unobtrusive, objective, non-stigmatizing digital proxy for psychiatric monitoring.

2. Multimodal Feature Synergy: Bridge 21 domain digital biomarkers with 1D-CNN temporal representations.

3. Transparent Decision Support: Explainable AI (SHAP) + automated DSM-5 clinical consultation memos.

§ 03 • Methodological Discovery

Reaching 99.62% Window Accuracy & The "Leakage Trap"

Reproducing Arora et al. (2023) exposes the pervasive methodological flaw in published actigraphy literature

Reproduction & Layer Scaling (Arora et al. 2023)

We faithfully reproduced the supervisor's published hybrid BiLSTM-SVM architecture under 10-fold window-level cross-validation (1,331 windows):

Architecture ConfigurationLayersWindow AccROC-AUCCorrect
Published Arora et al. (2023)L = 295.57%——
Our Faithful Reproduction (BiLSTM-2 + SVM)L = 296.39%0.99391,283 / 1,331
★ Our Scaled Depth Model (BiLSTM-3 + SVM)L = 399.62%0.99971,326 / 1,331
Our Saturated Model (BiLSTM-4 + SVM)L = 497.37%0.99611,296 / 1,331
99.62%
Window-Level Accuracy (1,326 / 1,331 Windows)
The Critical Flaw: Subject Identity Memorization

Why is 99.62% an empirical illusion?

  • 50% Window Overlap: 24-hour windows are sliced with a 12-hour hop size. Slices $t$ and $t+1$ share 720 identical minute points.
  • Cross-Partition Bleeding: In standard random K-fold CV, windows from the same subject are placed simultaneously into both Train and Test sets.
  • Biometric Identity Fingerprinting: Deep sequential models memorize individual idiosyncratic habits (bedtime, pace, restlessness) rather than generalizable depression pathology.
  • Clinical Collapse: When deployed in clinical practice on an entirely new unseen patient, such window-trained models collapse completely.
LEAKAGE
Standard K-Fold Breaches Subject Isolation
§ 04 • Literature Reality Check

The LOSO Dilemma: Literature Collapses on Unseen Patients

When evaluated under strict Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation, published models drop to 71%–73%

Comparative Literature Benchmark
Study & ReferenceModel & FeaturesSplit ProtocolReported Accuracy
Garcia-Ceja et al. (2018) Linear SVM (3 basic stats) Window 10-fold CV 72.70% (Window level)
Frogner et al. (2019) 1D-CNN (1-min raw series) Window 10-fold CV 71.00%
Jakobsen et al. (2020) Deep Neural Network Subject-level split 84.00% (Subtypes)
Arora et al. (2023) BiLSTM-2 + SVM Window 10-fold CV 95.57% (High due to leakage)
Literature Baseline on LOSO Linear SVM (3 basic stats) 55-Fold LOSO (Subject) 71.06% Bal Acc (Sensitivity: 60.87%)

*Note: Under strict 55-fold LOSO, the literature baseline fails to detect 9 out of 23 depressed patients (nearly 40% false-negative rate).

Why Is Patient Generalization So Challenging?
  • Inter-Subject Biological Variance: Divergent chronotypes (night owls vs early risers), occupations, medication regimes, and age differences.
  • Small Clinical Sample Sizes ($N=55$): High dimensional time-series data relative to limited participant cohorts.
  • Diagnostic Question: Can we design a multimodal architecture that achieves >90% diagnostic accuracy on completely unseen patients without a single byte of data leakage?
71.06%
Literature Baseline on 55-Fold Strict LOSO
§ 05 • Methodological Innovation

Dual-Branch Architecture: Statistical vs. Deep Learning

Capturing complementary diagnostic signals under strict 55-fold nested LOSO cross-validation

Branch 1: 21 Domain Digital Biomarkers
  • Distributional Metrics (9): Mean, Std, Median, Q1, Q3, IQR, Max, Skewness, Kurtosis.
  • Movement Volatility & Dynamics (5): Zero-Activity Ratio, CV, MASD, RMSSD, Lag-1 Autocorrelation.
  • Circadian & Diurnal Metrics (7): Daytime Mean, Nocturnal Mean, Day/Night Inactivity Ratios, $M10$ (vigor), $L5$ (rest), Relative Amplitude ($RA$).

Result: Regularized Logistic Regression boosted balanced accuracy from 66.37% → 79.76% (+13.39%) and sensitivity to 78.26%.

79.76%
Statistical Champion (LogReg-21)
Branch 2: Temporal 1D-CNN Champion
  • Lightweight Deep Champion: Only 6,593 parameters. Outperformed complex recurrent nets (LSTM: 70.45%, GRU: 74.46%).
  • Resolution Benchmark: Hourly downsampling ($T=24$) beat unaggregated 1-minute ($T=1,440$) by suppressing sensor noise.
  • Performance: Reached 79.76% Balanced Accuracy and 0.8899 ROC-AUC.

§ 08 • Bedside AI System

Clinical AI Co-Pilot & Interactive Web Dashboard

Translating machine learning models into actionable, interpretable bedside psychiatric decision support

Generative AI Clinical Consultation Co-Pilot
  • DSM-5 Aligned Documentation: Automatically synthesizes clinical consultation memos incorporating MADRS changes, biomarker Z-scores, and calibrated risk stratifications.
  • Deviation Analysis: Computes subject Z-scores against normative healthy control distributions.
Forensic Audit of the 4 Residual Borderline Cases:

1. condition_2 (FN, p=0.41): MADRS dropped from 24 to 11 (clinical remission; model detected restored vitality).
2. condition_16 (FN, p=0.43): Baseline MADRS was 13 (mildest borderline depression in cohort).
3. control_4 (FP, p=0.52) & control_32 (FP, p=0.58): Highly sedentary and elderly subjects.

§ 09 • Conclusion & Future Work

Key Contributions & Research Roadmap

Summary of academic deliverables for DTU B.Tech Project Group GP178

1. Exposing Methodological Bias

Demonstrated that published 95%–99.6% window accuracies suffer from subject identity leakage.

Proved that strict Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) is mandatory for clinical validity in wearable actigraphy.

2. Breakthrough Multimodal Fusion

Shattered the literature LOSO ceiling, elevating balanced accuracy from 71.06% → 92.53% (+21.47%).

Correctly diagnosed 51 of 55 unseen patients with 91.30% sensitivity and 0.9470 ROC-AUC ($p=0.0076$).

3. Clinically Aligned System

Identified Daytime Sedentary Ratio and Relative Amplitude as key physiological biomarkers via SHAP.

Delivered an interpretable AI Co-Pilot with automated DSM-5 consultation notes and web dashboard.

Future Research Directions:

• Multimodal Sensor Fusion: Incorporate continuous Photoplethysmography (PPG / Heart Rate Variability) and skin temperature.
• Prospective Clinical Trials: Test in longitudinal hospital outpatient clinics on consumer smartwatches (Apple Watch / WearOS).
